exact_statement: For every n>=1 and every fresh disjoint block partition of n, the nested constant-seed activation tower is the Boolean point defect f_n=1-2*1{x=0}, with I=2n*2^(-n), H<=4I and H/I tending to 4. Every complete one-coordinate restriction tree, with irrelevant queries skipped, has blind exact-minority surcharge R=2^(-n)n(n-1), hence R/I=(n-1)/2. Retaining the exact base-two KL rebate gives Q<=2I and, for n>=2, 1-1/n<=Q/I<=1+3/n, hence Q/I tends to 1. For disjoint products and sequential factor trees, H,I,R,Q add.
